items.text: Broncos WR Jaylen Waddle questionable to return with shoulder injury in TNF vs SEA, then returned to the game.
items.why: Shoulder issue mid-game; cleared to return.
items.implication: Played through; monitor for lingering effects ROS.

items.text: Jalen Hurts ruled out indefinitely for Week 6 vs Panthers due to superficial blood clot in calf that showed movement; Tanner McKee to start. Treatment likely blood thinners preventing play until resolved.
items.why: Follow-up ultrasound revealed movement in clot after initial clearance to play Week 5.
items.implication: Eagles offense shifts to McKee; pass game and Hurts rushing upside gone short-term.
items.opportunity: McKee volume; potential WR/TE target increases if game script opens.

items.text: Texans RB David Montgomery (groin), WR Tank Dell (knee), S Jalen Pitre (shoulder) will not travel to London and ruled OUT vs Jaguars.
items.why: Did not practice; team decision not to travel.
items.implication: Texans RB committee shifts; reduced scoring potential in London.
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/carries for remaining Texans backs.

items.text: Cardinals RB Jeremiyah Love DNP second straight day (ankle); Bills WR DJ Moore DNP second straight day (shoulder).
items.why: Ankle management for Love; shoulder for Moore.
items.implication: Both trending doubtful/out; depth chart shifts.
items.opportunity: Other Cardinals RBs; Bills WR targets redistribute.

items.text: Saquon Barkley no practice again (hamstring); DeVonta Smith upgraded to limited practice (hamstring/toe).
items.why: Continued hamstring management for Barkley; Smith progress.
items.implication: Barkley questionable/unlikely; Smith trending toward possible play.
items.opportunity: If Barkley out, backup RB opportunity; Smith limited but targets possible.

items.text: Lamar Jackson officially DNP again (ankle); Rashee Rice DNP again (hamstring).
items.why: Ongoing recovery; Jackson day-to-day with realistic chance noted earlier.
items.implication: Jackson status uncertain for Browns; Rice limited post-bye.
items.opportunity: Huntley if Jackson out; Worthy/others if Rice limited.

items.text: Jalen Hurts out; likes Tanner McKee as fill-in start.
items.why: Solid backup in potentially pass-heavy script vs CAR.
items.implication: Viable streamer; lifts Eagles pass catchers slightly.

items.text: Loves Mike Evans vs WSH as WR4; Commanders defense buffet for pass catchers. All-in on Evans top-five WR play.
items.why: Elite matchup vs weak WSH secondary; volume and red-zone.
items.opportunity: Targets, deep shots, TDs vs leaky defense.

items.text: Loves Drake London vs CHI (WR6) for bankable usage; Kyren Williams vs ARI (RB5) elite recent usage vs leaky run D. Also Javonte Williams @GB (RB8) goal-line role, Rhamondre vs NYJ (RB9).
items.why: Usage/volume + soft matchups; Henderson multi-week out boosts Rhamondre.
items.implication: Priority starts; volume floors with upside.

items.text: Breece Hall week-to-week, no practice. RB snaps in two full games since injury: Braelon Allen 90, Isaiah Davis 12, Kene Nwangwu 0.
items.why: Snap dominance post-Hall injury confirms clear lead back.
items.implication: Allen locked in as primary if Hall misses more.
items.opportunity: Allen high snap share, goal-line/third-down potential.

items.text: Ravens WR Ja'Kobi Lane expected return to practice 4 weeks post-wrist surgery; shot to play this weekend. Generated huge offseason buzz, elite YPP context even without full Lamar snaps (offense 6.4 YPP).
items.why: Surgery recovery complete; prior camp role and offense efficiency.
items.implication: Potential target share in high-efficiency Ravens offense.

items.text: Eagles gold standard moving on from aging stars early (Dawkins, McNabb, McCoy etc.). Saquon turns 30 in Feb; if Super Bowl contender with RB need, at least call. Agrees risk of year too early better than too late.
items.why: Age and Eagles precedent for proactive moves.
items.implication: Potential trade candidate; value may shift if contenders call.
items.opportunity: Handcuff or destination RB upside if moved.

items.text: Hates Jaylen Waddle vs SEA (WR28) tough matchup; Bo Nix vs SEA (QB23) toughest pass D and playing scared; also Egbuka, Pitts, Marks, Dobbins, Herbert.
items.why: Ugly matchups, shaky QB play, low team totals, role issues.
items.conflict: Waddle returned mid-TNF but still tough spot.

items.text: Post-MHJ trade, Kendrick Bourne expected to get open more and earn more targets than MHJ did. Thorman Week 6 rankings live; Man vs Machine Week 6 with Levitan.
items.why: Scheme fit and target opportunity post-trade.
items.implication: Bourne waiver/start bump; MHJ Texans debut London.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets for Bourne in new role.
